title: Engenheiro de Software Senior Backend (Ruby on Rails)
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1.Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:


  • Dominam Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Têm experiência em Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Têm experiência em Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Têm experiência em Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Têm experiência com Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Têm Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Têm Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Habilidade de alinhar contratos de API antecipadamente com os times de Front-end e Mobile para evitar bloqueios e garantir que a integração seja fluida.
  • Trabalham com Antecipação de Riscos (Atitude Dono): Capacidade de identificar gargalos ou requisitos ambíguos precocemente, levantando a mão e propondo soluções para evitar retrabalhos.
  • Trabalham em Equipe: Mentalidade colaborativa, compartilhando conhecimento e garantindo que o código seja legível e mantível para o restante do time.
  • Têm Autonomia: Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas alinhadas às convenções do Rails sem necessidade de microgerenciamento.


Diferencial (IA):

  • Uso de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a escrita de código e geração de mocks de dados.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas, abertas a pessoas de todos os perfis e experiências.

Ative o seu potencial com a gente. Candidate-se e venha crescer com o Grupo Smart Fit.

title: Senior Customer Education
description:
About the Role


Our education platform is a central learning hub for both customers and internal teams. With a large and growing base of users, we’ve reached a point where we need to scale the program more intentionally — with more structured learning paths, meaningful certifications, and content that directly connects to product adoption and retention.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with strong execution skills: someone who can design an end-to-end educational program and turn it into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture of the education program — learning paths, certifications, and journeys aligned with the customer lifecycle and different user profiles
  • Develop and maintain courses and learning paths with high instructional quality and strong alignment with the product, in both Portuguese and English
  • Script educational videos and collaborate with recording and editing teams to ensure production consistency
  • Create and execute engagement strategies to convert users into active learners and drive progression through learning paths
  • Define and monitor program KPIs — activation, completion, and active engagement — connecting learning behavior to retention and expansion metrics
  • Turn usage data into portfolio decisions: what to prioritize, update, or discontinue
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to keep content up to date and identify knowledge gaps that impact adoption
  • Support internal enablement initiatives


Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer education, instructional design, or e-learning — preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing educational programs within LMS platforms (not just operating them, but designing structure and analyzing data)
  • Ability to connect learning behavior to business metrics such as adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Experience scripting and producing educational videos independently
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English — able to create and script content in both languages
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to educational content production workflows


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led Growth (SLG) models
  • Experience with product education and scalable learning programs
  • Experience with user reactivation strategies or engagement management in educational programs
  • Strategic use of AI to optimize content production, curation, and updates

title: AR / Billing Analyst
description:
Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.


Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and issue customer invoices accurately and in a timely manner
  • Ensure billing aligns with customer contracts, pricing terms, and invoicing schedules
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.g., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter


Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an active hands-on contributor as well as a strong influencer for our technical direction. You will be able to lead and contribute to significant initiatives as well as provide mentorship through code reviews and pairing.

We are especially excited to hear from you if you are enthusiastic about working in the luxury retail/e-commerce space or passionate about our mission to create a circular economy for high-end goods.

This role reports to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience and will be fully remote.


What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience

- Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event-based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce , the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods.


Bonus Points

Experience with Kafka for event-streaming

Experience extracting microservices from a monolith


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior Customer Education
description:
About the Role


Our education platform is a central learning hub for both customers and internal teams. With a large and growing base of users, we’ve reached a point where we need to scale the program more intentionally — with more structured learning paths, meaningful certifications, and content that directly connects to product adoption and retention.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with strong execution skills: someone who can design an end-to-end educational program and turn it into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture of the education program — learning paths, certifications, and journeys aligned with the customer lifecycle and different user profiles
  • Develop and maintain courses and learning paths with high instructional quality and strong alignment with the product, in both Portuguese and English
  • Script educational videos and collaborate with recording and editing teams to ensure production consistency
  • Create and execute engagement strategies to convert users into active learners and drive progression through learning paths
  • Define and monitor program KPIs — activation, completion, and active engagement — connecting learning behavior to retention and expansion metrics
  • Turn usage data into portfolio decisions: what to prioritize, update, or discontinue
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to keep content up to date and identify knowledge gaps that impact adoption
  • Support internal enablement initiatives


Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer education, instructional design, or e-learning — preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing educational programs within LMS platforms (not just operating them, but designing structure and analyzing data)
  • Ability to connect learning behavior to business metrics such as adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Experience scripting and producing educational videos independently
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English — able to create and script content in both languages
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to educational content production workflows


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led Growth (SLG) models
  • Experience with product education and scalable learning programs
  • Experience with user reactivation strategies or engagement management in educational programs
  • Strategic use of AI to optimize content production, curation, and updates

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Modelo Híbrido; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software II
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Analisar e compreender requisitos de negócio em conjunto com product managers e analistas, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas
  • Projetar arquiteturas de software e definir soluções técnicas para features de crédito, considerando escalabilidade, segurança e performance
  • Desenvolver código de produção seguindo padrões de qualidade, boas práticas de programação e convenções estabelecidas pelo time
  • Escrever e manter testes unitários, de integração e end-to-end para garantir qualidade e confiabilidade do código
  • Realizar code reviews de forma construtiva, garantindo qualidade técnica e alinhamento com padrões do time
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, retrospectiva) contribuindo com insights técnicos e de negócio
  • Colaborar com designers e product managers na definição de soluções que equilibrem viabilidade técnica e necessidades do usuário
  • Investigar e resolver problemas em produção, analisando logs, métricas e comportamento do sistema para identificar causas raiz
  • Monitorar métricas de performance, disponibilidade e saúde dos sistemas de crédito em produção
  • Documentar decisões técnicas, arquiteturas e processos de desenvolvimento para facilitar manutenção e onboarding
  • Refatorar código legado quando necessário, melhorando qualidade, legibilidade e manutenibilidade sem alterar comportamento
  • Participar de discussões sobre evolução de produtos de crédito, propondo melhorias técnicas e de negócio baseadas em dados
  • Garantir segurança e conformidade nas soluções desenvolvidas, seguindo práticas de segurança da informação e regulamentações do setor financeiro
  • Colaborar na definição e evolução de padrões técnicos, ferramentas e processos de desenvolvimento do time
  • Investigar e corrigir bugs reportados pela operação ou identificados através de monitoramento, priorizando impacto no negócio



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Node.js (runtime, event loop, módulos nativos, performance)
  • TypeScript (tipos avançados, generics, decorators, utility types)
  • JavaScript ES6+ (async/await, promises, destructuring, spread operator)
  • SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) - queries complexas, otimização, índices, transações
  • NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) - modelagem de dados, agregações, cache strategies
  • ORMs e Query Builders (TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize, Knex)
  • Migrations e versionamento de schema
  • Docker (Dockerfile, docker-compose)
  • Conceitos de containers, volumes, networks
  • Boas práticas de containerização para aplicações Node.js ;
  • Git (branching strategies, merge/rebase, hooks)
  • CI/CD (Bitbucket CI, GitLab CI) - pipelines, testes automatizados, deploy
  • Clean Code e SOLID principles
  • Design Patterns (Factory, Strategy, Repository, Dependency Injection)
  • Arquitetura de software (RESTful APIs, microserviços, event-driven)
  • Testes (unitários, integração, E2E) - Jest, Mocha, Chai, Supertest
  • Code review e pair programming
  • Gerenciadores de pacotes (npm, yarn, pnpm)
  • Debugging (Node.js ;debugger, Chrome DevTools)
  • Monitoramento e logging (Winston, Pino, Sentry)
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Documentação técnica (API docs, arquitetura, ADRs)
  • Versionamento semântico (SemVer)

title: Analista Administrativo
description:
Estamos com uma oportunidade para Analista Administrativo, com atuação 100% presencial em um de nossos escritórios na cidade de Salvador/BA . Este/a profissional terá as seguintes atribuições principais:


  • Apoiar no controle e organização de documentos;
  • Realizar interface com fornecedores locais (aluguel, serviços, materiais de escritório);
  • Apoiar em rotinas financeiras básicas (lançamentos, conferências e organização de notas fiscais);
  • Suportar às demandas administrativas do time local;
  • Apoiar às áreas corporativas, quando necessário (RH, Financeiro e Facilities).


Perfil Requerido:

  • Graduação Superior completa em Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência profissional anterior em rotinas administrativas e no contato com fornecedores;
  • Conhecimentos dos principais softwares do Pacote Office (Excel, Power Point e Word);
  • Além do alinhamento à Cultura da empresa, serão valorizadas as seguintes habilidades: senso crítico e atenção aos detalhes, controle e gestão do tempo, facilidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar sob o regime 100% presencial na cidade de Salvador/BA.



Quem Somos:


A Nova Infra Invest é uma empresa com mais de 30 anos de experiência em estruturação, execução e operação no setor de infraestrutura em projetos de Energia, Transporte, Irrigação, Saneamento e Meio Ambiente em diversos países da América Latina.


Nosso foco é fornecer soluções de infraestrutura diferenciadas e completas, capacidade de negócios e criação de valor sustentável para clientes, usuários, partes interessadas e a sociedade em geral, atuando atualmente no Peru e no Panamá.



Nosso Propósito:


Conectar pessoas e impulsionar o desenvolvimento sustentável da sociedade, identificando suas necessidades de infraestrutura e promovendo soluções abrangentes para o benefício das comunidades.


  • São US$ 7 bilhões provenientes de projetos estruturados como Parcerias Público-Privadas (PPPs) nos setores de energia, transporte e água.
  • 1700 km de rodovias sob nossa concessão no Peru e no Panamá. Nos posicionando como a maior operadora privada de rodovias com pedágio nesses países.
  • 38.000 hectares irrigados por meio de duas concessões de abastecimento de água no Peru.



Nossos Valores Diferenciadores:


Combinamos capacidade empreendedora e experiência na execução e operação de ativos de infraestrutura, beneficiando nossos clientes, usuários e comunidades nas regiões onde atuamos.


Temos uma equipe diversificada, com pessoas de diferentes nacionalidades e especialidades, que trabalham juntas para impulsionar o desenvolvimento sustentável em benefício da sociedade. Atuamos no Peru e no Panamá e consideramos toda a América Latina um mercado potencial.

Instagram: @novainfrainvest

title: Engenheiro de Software SR | Modernização & IA
description:
Muito prazer, Somos a Evertec!


A Evertec é uma empresa especializada em tecnologia para o setor financeiro , com mais de 27 anos de atuação e presença em 26 países da América Latina e Caribe. Com mais de 11 bilhões de transações processadas anualmente, somos referência em soluções que impulsionam a transformação digital do mercado.

Oferecemos um portfólio completo de soluções em software , atendendo instituições financeiras, empresas e fintechs que buscam inovação, segurança e eficiência .

Nosso compromisso é com a excelência tecnológica , a inclusão financeira e a geração de valor sustentável para clientes, colaboradores e parceiros, promovendo um ecossistema mais conectado e acessível.


A área de AI Office é responsável por iniciativas e direcionamentos de IA na empresa e busca um Engenheiro de Software Sênior para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução


Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Pesquisa em IA

  • Conhecimentos avançados em uso de IA
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de novos produtos
  • Histórico robusto em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software.

  • Habilidade comprovada em integrar diferentes áreas e alcançar alta performance.

  • Experiência prática em automação e otimização de processos empresariais.

Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:

  • Conhecimento avançados em IA e especialização em Software
  • Capacidade analítica em grandes volumes de dados.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Data Engineer (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering, Computer Science, or similar;
  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles;
  • Strong experience with data pipeline design and development (batch and streaming);
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Scala for data processing;
  • Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational data modeling;
  • Experience with big data frameworks (Apache Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or similar);
  • Hands-on experience with cloud data platforms (Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS Glue, Redshift, or similar);
  • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and lakehouse architectures;
  • Familiarity with data governance and data quality practices;
  • Excellent English skills (C1/C2);
  • Availability to relocate to Portugal.


Nice to have

  • Experience with dbt, Delta Lake, or Apache Iceberg;
  • Familiarity with real-time/streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink);
  • Knowledge of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar);


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Versatility (you can be a fan of BYOD or not);
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;

  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: 1st Level Tech Support Agent
description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

title: Data Project Manager (remote)
description:
A Brunel está apoiando uma empresa referência em soluções de dados e analytics na busca por um(a) Gerente de Projetos de Dados .


Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na condução de iniciativas end-to-end — desde a fase de discovery até o go-live — atuando como ponte entre áreas técnicas e de negócio. O desafio envolve liderar projetos complexos de dados, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade, dentro do prazo e alinhadas aos objetivos da organização.


Buscamos um perfil que una forte experiência em gestão de projetos com repertório técnico em dados, capaz de navegar com autonomia entre stakeholders, engenharia e decisões de arquitetura.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos de dados de média e alta complexidade (data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, BI, migração de dados, entre outros).
  • Definir e gerenciar escopo, cronograma, orçamento, recursos e riscos.
  • Conduzir cerimônias ágeis (dailies, sprints, retrospectivas) e adaptar frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, híbrido) conforme o contexto.
  • Atuar como interface entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em planos de execução claros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de projeto (velocity, burn-down, progresso) e comunicar status para diferentes níveis da organização.
  • Antecipar riscos, dependências e gargalos, propondo planos de mitigação.
  • Gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros envolvidos nas entregas.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada de processos, decisões e aprendizados.
  • Impulsionar melhoria contínua nas práticas de gestão de projetos da área de dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência consolidada (5+ anos) em gestão de projetos de tecnologia, sendo ao menos 2 anos em projetos de dados ou analytics.
  • Conhecimento prático do ecossistema de dados: data warehouse, data lake, ETL/ELT, modelagem de dados e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Qlik, Tableau ou similares).
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis e tradicionais (Scrum, Kanban, PMBOK/Waterfall), com flexibilidade de aplicação.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Azure DevOps, Monday, Asana ou similares).
  • Forte habilidade de gestão de stakeholders e comunicação executiva.
  • Capacidade de interpretar documentação técnica (arquitetura, modelos de dados, integrações).
  • Inglês fluente (interação constante com times e stakeholders internacionais).


Diferenciais

  • Background técnico prévio (Data Analyst, Data Engineer ou BI Developer).
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP).
  • Uso de soluções de IA como aceleradores de entrega.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para validações básicas.
  • Vivência com change management em contextos data-driven.
  • Conhecimento em governança de dados (ex: DAMA-DMBOK).
  • Certificações (PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, PSM, SAFe ou similares).
  • Experiência com gestão de portfólio e priorização estratégica.

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

description:

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Mode: Full Time


Responsibilities:

Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of advanced analytics solutions using Azure Databricks/ Fabric. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of big data technologies, data engineering, and cloud computing, with a strong focus on Azure Databricks along with Strong SQL.

Work closely with business stakeholders and other IT teams to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

Strong experience with Azure Databricks , including cluster management, notebook development, and Delta Lake.

Proficiency in big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) and data processing frameworks (e.g., PySpark).

Deep understanding of Azure services like Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Factory. Power BI, SSRS, SSAS, PSKU to F SKU.

Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, and building data lakes.

Strong SQL skills and familiarity with NoSQL databases.

Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git.

Knowledge of cloud security best practices.


Experience:

Demonstrated expertise of 12+ years in developing data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Databricks/Synapse notebooks and Azure Data Factory.

Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Delta tables, Delta Lake, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2.

Experience in efficiently using Auto Loader and Delta Live tables for seamless data ingestion and transformation.

Proficiency in building and optimizing query layers using Databricks SQL.

Demonstrated experience integrating Databricks with Azure Synapse, ADLS Gen2, and Power BI for end-to-end analytics solutions.

Prior experience in developing, optimizing, and deploying Power BI reports.

Familiarity with modern CI/CD practices, especially in the context of Databricks and cloud-native solutions.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Transforme o futuro com a Minsait


Na Minsai t, acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças.

Aqui, você encontra um ambiente que valoriza a autonomia, a colaboração e o crescimento contínuo, com projetos desafiadores e oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento.


Nosso jeito de ser

  • Inovamos com propósito
  • Crescemos com responsabilidade
  • Valorizamos a diversidade e quem transforma


Valores

  • Inovação, conexão, confiança e antecipação de futuro


Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.



Descrição Geral do Cargo:


Você vai projetar e evoluir soluções de IA generativa para uso real em negócio, com foco em agentes, prompting, RAG e avaliação. Procuramos alguém que saiba transformar necessidade em solução robusta, com guardrails, qualidade e melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

• Desenhar agentes (agent workflows), ferramentas (tool calling) e prompts para casos de uso reais.

• Construir/evoluir pipelines de RAG (ingestão, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, reranking, grounding).

• Definir guardrails e políticas: segurança, privacidade, compliance, prevenção de alucinação.

• Criar estratégia de avaliação: métricas, datasets, testes automatizados, critérios de aceite.

• Otimizar qualidade e custo (latência, contexto, taxas de erro, cache, roteamento de modelos).

• Trabalhar em parceria com engenharia para produção (logs, auditoria, monitoramento, versionamento).

Requisitos obrigatórios

• Experiência prática com LLMs e IA aplicada (ex.: agentes, prompting, RAG).

• Boa base em Python e engenharia de experimentação (reprodutibilidade, testes, métricas).

• Conhecimento de técnicas de recuperação (vetores/embeddings, busca híbrida, rerank).

• Experiência ou familiaridade com avaliação de qualidade (offline/online) e redução de erro.

• Capacidade de comunicar decisões técnicas de forma clara para negócio e engenharia.

Diferenciais (desejáveis)

• Experiência no setor financeiro e/ou processos de risco, fraude, crédito, operações, compliance.

• Experiência com fine-tuning, eval frameworks e observabilidade de LLM.

• Vivência com ambientes regulados e requisitos de auditabilidade.



Idiomas:

Espanhol



TRABALHE NA MINSAIT


  • Modelo de contratação CLT.
  • Plano de Saúde subsidiado pela empresa para o titular.
  • Opção de inclusão de dependentes no Plano de Saúde com desconto em folha de pagamento.
  • Assistência Odontológica (opcional).
  • Vale Refeição no cartão Flash Benefícios.
  • Vale Transporte (opcional).
  • POP - Programa de Orientação Pessoal que visa oferecer suporte emocional e aconselhamento com orientação confidencial nas áreas psicológica, jurídica, financeira, social e pet sem custo para titular e dependentes legais.
  • Plataforma de Saúde Wellhub-Gympass (Acesso a mais de 700 academias em todo o Brasil com planos descontado em folha de pagamento).
  • Parcerias com grandes marcas de consumo.
  • Convênio com o SESC para titular e dependentes.
  • Convênios para descontos com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação) e escola de idiomas.
  • Seguro de vida em grupo.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade é um elemento-chave da nossa cultura: Igualdade de oportunidades, respeito pelas pessoas e não discriminação são princípios de atuação para todos os profissionais da Minsait. Integramos o Bloomberg Gender-Equality Index (GEI) 2021 em termos de diversidade e igualdade de gênero.

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Forensic Manager
description:
This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations.


Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.


Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.


In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.


To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.


While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.
