title: Full-Stack Senior PHP Developer
description:
Are you passionate about building enterprise grade software applications that people depend on? Do you care that your work makes life better for people around the world? 


We’re building a Latam based fullstack software engineering team to scale and enhance our award winning cloud-based educational technology platform. After establishing a strong product with a fully remote U.S. team while 2xing revenue year over year, we’re now looking for the inaugural elite members to build and grow our Latam team. 


Consider this a unique opportunity to work with a U.S. based product company of top engineers and product executives, make an impact by improving education, and be part of a rocket ship!


About You


  • Versatile and hands-on doer, starter attitude
  • Empathetic and humble, you are respectful, optimistic, have the capacity to commit to disagreement when needed, and take ownership
  • Ability and willingness to work cross-functionally
  • Experience working with non-tech colleagues


Core Responsibilities


  • Develop PHP based features end to end
  • Address complex refactoring challenges in legacy PHP systems
  • Debug and repair broken or overly buggy code
  • Contribute to code reviews, QA, and an Agile development process
  • Participate in architectural planning and technical roadmapping


Must Have


  • 3+ years building full-stack applications with PHP backend
  • English Fluency
  • Experience writing front end JavaScript
  • Experience with SQL
  • API development expertise
  • Collaborative mindset with ability to work independently
  • Growth-oriented approach


Nice to Have


  • Modern PHP framework knowledge such as Laravel
  • Component-based JS framework experience
  • Cloud deployments experience
  • Test automation experience
  • Microservices development experience
  • Educational software or SaaS platforms expertise
  • Data integration expertise
  • Enthusiastic about learning and teaching others


What You’ll Get


An opportunity for uncommonly fast career growth. Work in a supportive, collaborative, and creative environment where you can thrive personally and professionally


  • Above market salary in local market
  • Flexible PTO and vacation policy
  • Flexible, family-friendly schedule to help you achieve work/life balance
  • Exposure to the US education technology industry
  • Exposure to industry C-suite executives and valuable networking experiences
  • Team up alongside a group of down to earth people looking to level up and build something big
  • Full-time remote position


We are an equal opportunity employer. No recruiters, please.


— FAQ —


What would be my career trajectory?


As a company, we have a very flat hierarchy. Your direct manager will be the VP of Engineering and his boss the Co-founder and Chief Product Officer. If you care about building experience by cultivating high-functioning teams, releasing great software, accomplishing goals, and learning new things, this is the right place for you. If you care about titles and meetings and titles, this is not the right place for you. Our belief is there will always be “the next job” so push yourself to learn and grow in the time you are here.


What is work like here?


We’re a Series B funded education technology platform. Think of us as a startup but without all of the early stage business and funding risks. It also means no corporate atmosphere with a strict dress code, and no stuffy bureaucracy to drown out your ideas. We value every team member and if we hire you, it’s because we think you can do great things with us. We aren’t going to sugar-coat everything. We have our challenges like every other business. Where we separate ourselves is having the willingness and motivation to take our challenges head-on before they grow.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: US Payroll Analyst
description:
The main objective of this role is to review payroll data and documentation for assigned clients, ensuring that all values are accurate based on employees worked hours, guaranteeing traceability and providing consistent, value-added support to clients.


Responsibilities:


  • Review quarterly and annual reports to ensure proper submission of payroll records to the IRS.
  • Input client-reported information for payroll processing.
  • Follow up with clients through meetings and emails to ensure that the information entered into ADP/Accountants World is accurate.
  • Enter information into the Accountants World platform for quarterly clients.
  • Review 1099 forms annually in accordance with information provided by Account Managers.
  • Perform all tasks related to the role based on knowledge and capabilities.

Experience:


  • Minimum of 1 year supporting payroll processes.
  • Advanced English level – required.

  • Customer Orientation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Learning Agility
  • Communication
  • Teamwork

title: Consultor SAP Concur
description:
Temos 3 vagas disponível para essa posição, com diferentes senioridades: Pleno, Sênior e Especialista. Vem fazer parte do time!!!


Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho (Pode variar de acordo com as posições):

  • Atuar em processos de despesas (Expense), viagens corporativas (Travel) e contas a pagar (Invoice), de acordo com as instruções do cliente;
  • Apoiar usuários e aprovadores em dúvidas operacionais e uso da solução (web e mobile);

title: Client Services Associate
description:
Client Services Associate

Remote – Brazil / Full-time / R$120,000–155,000/year / Remote / Permanent / 0–2 Years Exp / Market Research Graduates Welcome


ABOUT CLEARLIGHT INSIGHTS

Clearlight Insights is a US-registered market research agency that partners with leading market research and consulting firms to deliver high-quality primary and secondary research. We work across a broad range of research mandates - from large-scale quantitative studies to nuanced qualitative explorations - and are growing our client-facing team in the UK.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a permanent, full-time remote role based in Brazil, ideal for a motivated graduate or early-career professional looking to build a career at the intersection of research, consulting, and client services. You'll be the voice of Clearlight Insights to prospective and existing clients - reaching out, building relationships, attending and facilitating client meetings, and supporting account management activities that keep our partnerships running smoothly.

You don't need years of experience - you need sharp communication skills, a proactive mindset, and a genuine interest in market research and consulting. All work is conducted in English with a global client base.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Identify and reach out to prospective clients via email and LinkedIn to generate new business conversations

• Draft and send tailored outreach messages that represent Clearlight Insights professionally and compellingly

• Schedule, coordinate, and attend client meetings - preparing agendas, taking notes, and ensuring clear follow-through on next steps

• Participate actively in calls and video meetings with clients, building rapport and representing the agency confidently

• Support account management activities - following up on ongoing projects, maintaining client records, and ensuring client satisfaction

• Track outreach activity, pipeline, and meeting outcomes using CRM tools

• Collaborate with the research delivery team to ensure client briefs are well understood and acted upon

• Help identify opportunities to grow existing client accounts


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• A recent graduate or early-career professional with 0–2 years of experience - degrees or postgraduate qualifications in business, marketing, market research, social sciences, or a related field are a plus

• Fluent English - written and spoken - is a hard requirement; all client communication, meetings, and internal collaboration are conducted in English

• Excellent communicator - confident, professional, and personable; comfortable holding your own in video meetings with senior international stakeholders

• Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple client threads and follow-ups at once

• Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a fully remote setup

• Comfortable working across time zones - some overlap with US and European business hours will be required

• Familiarity with LinkedIn, email outreach, and basic CRM tools is a bonus but not required

• An interest in or exposure to market research, consulting, or B2B services is highly desirable


WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive salary of R$120k–155k per year

• Permanent, full-time role with genuine long-term growth prospects

• Fully remote - work from anywhere in Brazil

• Real client exposure from day one - this is not a back-office role

• A collaborative, international team with a flat structure and direct access to senior leadership

• A strong foundation for a career in client services, business development, or research consulting


If you're ambitious, articulate, and eager to grow in a fast-paced research environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV and a brief note (feel free to add a cover letter!) on why this role interests you.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — AWS Serverless (Remote)
description:
About EverUp

We’re a UK startup making gift-card shopping rewarding. Our mobile app (React Native) and web (React) run on a serverless AWS backend. We’re hiring a Backend Cloud Engineer to evolve and maintain the APIs, databases, and services that power payments, wallet, rewards, and near-real-time features.

The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile/Web.

What you’ll do

  • Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP/REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core ; implement authentication/authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST/HTTP.
  • Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.
  • Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS/SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics/logs and alarms.
  • Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM/CloudFormation), CI/CD pipelines, and environment promotions.
  • Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud/risk, analytics and support tooling.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.
  • Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).

Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST/WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation/SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech/comms integrations (Open Banking/PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

  • 8+ years building/maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript/Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.
  • Solid SQL/NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).
  • Experience maintaining IaC (SAM/CloudFormation) and CI/CD (Code Pipeline).
  • Security-first mindset and practical debugging/troubleshooting chops (OWASP).
  • WebSocket/API Gateway connection management and real-time features.
  • Payments/fintech and fraud/risk integrations.
  • Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.
  • Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines/warehousing exposure.

How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

  • Intro call
  • Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution)
  • Practical walkthrough (IaC/API/data-modeling maintenance scenario)
  • Founder/lead chat & references

Equal opportunity

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective.

How to apply

Send your CV, GitHub/portfolio, and a brief note describing a production backend you maintained/evolved and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: AI Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description:
AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities

  • Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.g., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops.
  • Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data.
  • System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes.
  • Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience.
  • QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify \"Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment.
  • Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions.

AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation.
  • Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows.
  • Technical Foundation:
  • Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data).
  • Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering .
  • Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.g., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Engineering Design Specialist - 72123
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals.
  • Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance.


Domain Tracks:

You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g; expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus.

  • Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems.
  • Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design.
  • Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry.
  • Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification.
  • Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design.
  • Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference.
  • Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads.
  • Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design.
  • Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design.
  • Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration.
  • Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis).
  • Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain.
  • Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills.
  • High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.


Responsibilities

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer
description:
We are seeking a contractor to provide day-to-day remote support for an ageing 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment supporting HPC clusters within a data center setting. The engagement is focused on operational support, incident resolution, system health monitoring, filesystem support, and critical escalation coverage outside standard business hours. The IBM ESS Storage Support Engineer will be responsible for the ongoing support and maintenance of the storage environment. This includes monitoring, troubleshooting, break-fix support, routine health checks, and performance tuning of IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment. The role also requires participation in weekend on-call support for critical Severity 1 issues.


Location:

Brazil, Mexico


Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day remote operational support for a 4.5 PB IBM ESS storage environment
  • Monitor system health, alerts, capacity, and overall storage performance
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve storage-related incidents and service issues
  • Provide break-fix support and coordinate escalations where required
  • Support IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in an HPC environment
  • Assist with tuning and troubleshooting of parallel filesystem workloads
  • Carry out routine health checks and preventative maintenance activities
  • Support SAN-related troubleshooting, including fabric connectivity and multipathing
  • Participate in weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents only
  • Maintain clear documentation of incidents, resolutions, and operational recommendations


What we expect:

  • Proven hands-on experience with IBM ESS storage systems
  • Experience supporting IBM Spectrum Scale / GPFS in HPC environments
  • Good understanding of parallel filesystem workloads and HPC job patterns
  • Experience with SAN environments, including Brocade or Cisco fabrics, zoning, LUN masking, and multipathing
  • Strong Linux administration skills, particularly RHEL and SUSE
  • Working knowledge of the AIX command line
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken
  • Availability to work during EST business hours
  • Ability to provide weekend on-call support for Severity 1 incidents


Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting petabyte-scale storage environments
  • Background in data centre or scientific computing environments
  • Experience with performance tuning of GPFS / Spectrum Scale
  • Familiarity with supporting ageing infrastructure and maintaining operational stability
  • Experience in incident management and root cause analysis


We offer:

  • Highly competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
  • Continuous education, mentoring, and professional development programs
  • Strong management and tech expertise
  • 12-month contract with possible extension

  • Decomposição de Problemas: Traduzir desafios complexos de negócio em entregáveis técnicos claros e acionáveis e planos de trabalho.

  • Gestão de Trade-offs: Avaliar e gerenciar trade-offs entre diferentes abordagens técnicas, equilibrando entrega de curto prazo com sustentabilidade da plataforma no longo prazo.  
  • Planejamento de Roadmap & Entrega: Definir roadmaps de entrega e marcos, trabalhando com prazos e resultados claros.  
  • Colaboração Multifuncional: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com produto, ciência de dados, engenharia, operações e parceiros externos para entregar soluções de ponta a ponta. 
  • Governança & Qualidade: Garantir que as soluções atendam aos padrões arquiteturais, de segurança e operacionais à medida que entram em produção.  


Requisitos

  • Comunicação clara e eficaz com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.  
  • Experiência comprovada liderando desenvolvimento ponta a ponta e implantação em produção de soluções em nível empresarial.  
  • Experiência trabalhando com equipes internas e fornecedores externos para entregar soluções complexas.  
  • Experiência prática na construção de sistemas envolvendo integração de dados, harmonização, ETL e modelagem.  
  • Experiência implementando ou trabalhando com práticas de MLOps, incluindo implantação de modelos, monitoramento e gestão de ciclo de vida.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Node.js- Backend)
description:
About Us

HG Insights is the global leader in technology intelligence, delivering actionable AI driven insights through advanced data science and scalable big data solutions. Our platform informs go-to-market decisions, and we influence how businesses spend millions of marketing and sales budgets.

What You’ll Do

We’re searching for an experienced backend JavaScript engineer to join our product teams and help build systems that are simple, intuitive, and scalable. We develop big-data platforms using modern technologies and architectures, giving engineers the autonomy to learn, grow, and ship impactful products.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, and fellow engineers on our Insights Platform, designing and building reliable backend services that power great user experiences. Our backend stack is primarily based on Node.js .

What You’ll Be Responsible For

  • Work as part of our Product Engineering teams
  • Architect, design, and implement service-oriented backend systems and APIs
  • Build, maintain, and evolve RESTful APIs
  • Collaborate on ideas across the team, from concept through production
  • Fix bugs quickly while continuously improving system reliability and performance
  • Participate in our on-call rotation and help investigate and resolve production issues
  • Attend daily stand-ups and planning sessions, collaborate at a fast pace, and help raise the engineering bar


What You’ll Need

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent real-world experience
  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript , with a backend focus
  • Proven experience applying system and code design patterns in production environments
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Codex, Claude, Gemini) with advanced workflows
  • A self-learner and technology advocate comfortable working across different areas of the system
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-growing, high-ownership environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade SaaS applications with large datasets
  • Experience designing or building AI-powered features or systems
  • Experience working with Python
  • Enjoys startup culture where individual contributions are visible, impactful, and valued

title: SR. DevOps
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!


Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília!


Sobre a vaga:

O DevOps será responsável por projetar, implantar e manter soluções de monitoramento, telemetria e rastreabilidade em ambientes Azure, garantindo visibilidade completa sobre aplicações, containers e serviços serverless.


Responsabilidades:

  • Deverá configurar e integrar ferramentas como Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics e Container Insights, estabelecendo padrões de observabilidade que suportem o diagnóstico de incidentes, análise de desempenho e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.
  • Atuará na automação de monitoramento via IaC, integração com pipelines DevOps e na definição de métricas de confiabilidade (SLO/SLI/SLA) para aplicações críticas.
  • Será responsável por implementar e acompanhar métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Mean Time to Recovery e Change Failure Rate), promovendo uma cultura orientada a dados e melhoria contínua na entrega de software.


Requisitos:

  • Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Container Insights.
  • Coleta e correlação de logs, métricas e traces.
  • Observabilidade em ambientes serverless (Functions, Logic Apps, App Services).
  • Observabilidade de containers e clusters AKS (Kubernetes).
  • Criação de dashboards e alertas personalizados (KQL, Workbooks, Grafana).
  • Integração de Application Insights com pipelines DevOps e ferramentas de APM.
  • Monitoramento de performance de aplicações (APM) e rastreamento distribuído.
  • Conceitos de SLA, SLO e SLI e aplicação prática em ambientes produtivos.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep ou ARM) para provisionamento de recursos de observabilidade.
  • Automação de alertas e incidentes com Logic Apps, Azure Functions e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento de containers, Kubernetes, Helm e Prometheus.
  • Métricas DORA (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) e integração com pipelines DevOps.


Benefícios e Incentivos:

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;

  • TotalPass.

  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

description:

title: Gerente de design
description:
A Bas-alto é um estúdio de design full-service que trabalha com startups internacionais, atuando em projetos contínuos com clientes fixos nas áreas de product design, web design e marketing/growth design.

Estamos procurando um(a) Design Manager experiente para trabalhar de perto com o fundador do estúdio em diversos projetos simultâneos. Procuramos alguém confortável em transitar entre diferentes disciplinas, ajudando a conduzir projetos do conceito à execução, mantendo alto nível de qualidade e consistência.


Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o fundador do estúdio em múltiplos projetos ativos
  • Traduzir necessidades, objetivos e problemas em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para delegar à equipe de design
  • Gerenciar projetos, tarefas e entregas em plataformas como Asana, Jira, Clickup e Notion
  • Acompanhar o andamento de projetos de design em produto, web e marketing/growth
  • Ajudar a estruturar fluxos de trabalho, prioridades e cronogramas
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas


Importante: Fluência em inglês

Mais de 90% dos projetos do estúdio são internacionais. É necessária fluência em escrita e leitura em inglês para uma comunicação fluida com os stakeholders dos projetos, inclusive em linguagem técnica.


Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em product design e web design , com entendimento profundo de produtos digitais, interfaces web e mobile, fluxos de usuário, arquitetura de informação, usabilidade e boas práticas de UX e UI
  • Capacidade de compreender como aplicações web e mobile funcionam, incluindo noções de front-end (HTML, CSS e funcionamento geral de interfaces) para facilitar a comunicação com equipes de engenharia
  • Experiência sólida em branding e design gráfico , com domínio de composição, tipografia, hierarquia visual e refinamento estético nas entregas
  • Domínio avançado de Figma , incluindo Auto Layout, componentes, variáveis, organização de arquivos e construção de design systems
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e leitura). A maior parte dos clientes e da comunicação do dia a dia é em inglês
  • Extrema organização para manejar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e delegar tarefas com clareza
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e lidar com diferentes demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Forte atenção a detalhe e qualidade de execução


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência trabalhando com startups ou empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com design systems em escala
  • Noções de marketing e growth
  • Experiência como designer gráfico, designer de produto ou webdesigner


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário : a negociar, a partir de R$ 5.000+, conforme a experiência e o nível de senioridade.
  • Modelo de contratação : CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho : 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo, sem necessidade de presença física
  • Horário de trabalho flexível

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Projetos para atuar diretamente no suporte à gestão e execução de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento eficiente das atividades, controle de entregas e apoio nas rotinas operacionais do time.


O(a) profissional será responsável por organizar informações operacionais, apoiar os gerentes de projeto e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos internos.


Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar na estruturação e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos;
  • Realizar o controle e atualização de timesheets da equipe;
  • Monitorar indicadores e gerar dashboards de performance (Power BI, Excel, etc.);

  • Inglês avançado para conversa com stakeholders internacionais.

Nooro is developing an innovative APP that aims to revolutionize the health app market, helping individuals with various health issues. We are seeking ambitious and dedicated individuals to join our creative team!


IMPORTANT: We don’t want average. We want the top 1%. If you’re not at that level, don’t apply. Our decision will be based on the quality of your portfolio


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?


We need short-form video editors who are exceptional, period. You must live and breathe editing.


If you’re not constantly pushing for better, this isn’t for you.


We expect top-tier performance, fresh ideas, and relentless attention to detail in everything you do.


If you’re not aiming to be the best, don’t waste your time.


We value creativity and want individuals who can bring fresh ideas and innovations to our editing team.

  • Experience creating fast-paced content for Meta, Shorts, and TikTok - you should know how to make it grab attention immediately and how to keep it.

title: Advogado trabalhista
description:
Descrição da Empresa FOGAÇA ADVOGADOS ASSOC. é um escritório dedicado à excelência no campo jurídico, com atuação especializada em diversas áreas do Direito. Nossa equipe é reconhecida pelo compromisso em prestar serviços de alta qualidade e por adotar uma abordagem estratégica para garantir resultados eficientes para nossos clientes. Com uma visão que alia tradição e inovação, buscamos sempre soluções personalizadas para atender às necessidades específicas de quem confia em nosso trabalho.

title: Gerente de design
description:
A Bas-alto é um estúdio de design full-service que trabalha com startups internacionais, atuando em projetos contínuos com clientes fixos nas áreas de product design, web design e marketing/growth design.

Estamos procurando um(a) Design Manager experiente para trabalhar de perto com o fundador do estúdio em diversos projetos simultâneos. Procuramos alguém confortável em transitar entre diferentes disciplinas, ajudando a conduzir projetos do conceito à execução, mantendo alto nível de qualidade e consistência.


Responsabilidades:

  • Representar o fundador do estúdio em múltiplos projetos ativos
  • Traduzir necessidades, objetivos e problemas em projetos organizados, com escopo definido, prioridades claras e briefings executáveis para delegar à equipe de design
  • Gerenciar projetos, tarefas e entregas em plataformas como Asana, Jira, Clickup e Notion
  • Acompanhar o andamento de projetos de design em produto, web e marketing/growth
  • Ajudar a estruturar fluxos de trabalho, prioridades e cronogramas
  • Garantir qualidade e consistência nas entregas


Importante: Fluência em inglês

Mais de 90% dos projetos do estúdio são internacionais. É necessária fluência em escrita e leitura em inglês para uma comunicação fluida com os stakeholders dos projetos, inclusive em linguagem técnica.


Necessário:

  • Experiência sólida em product design e web design , com entendimento profundo de produtos digitais, interfaces web e mobile, fluxos de usuário, arquitetura de informação, usabilidade e boas práticas de UX e UI
  • Capacidade de compreender como aplicações web e mobile funcionam, incluindo noções de front-end (HTML, CSS e funcionamento geral de interfaces) para facilitar a comunicação com equipes de engenharia
  • Experiência sólida em branding e design gráfico , com domínio de composição, tipografia, hierarquia visual e refinamento estético nas entregas
  • Domínio avançado de Figma , incluindo Auto Layout, componentes, variáveis, organização de arquivos e construção de design systems
  • Inglês fluente (escrita e leitura). A maior parte dos clientes e da comunicação do dia a dia é em inglês
  • Extrema organização para manejar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e delegar tarefas com clareza
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e lidar com diferentes demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Forte atenção a detalhe e qualidade de execução


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência trabalhando com startups ou empresas de tecnologia
  • Experiência com design systems em escala
  • Noções de marketing e growth
  • Experiência como designer gráfico, designer de produto ou webdesigner


Remuneração e modelo

  • Salário : a negociar, a partir de R$ 5.000+, conforme a experiência e o nível de senioridade.
  • Modelo de contratação : CLT ou PJ, a negociar
  • Formato de trabalho : 100% remoto, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo, sem necessidade de presença física
  • Horário de trabalho flexível

title: Estágio em Operações Comerciais e Propostas
description:
Estágio em Operações Comerciais e Propostas | 100% Home Office | Inglês Avançado


A MLPro , consultoria com mais de 20 anos com PPM no ecossistema Microsoft , busca uma pessoa estagiária para atuar no apoio à rotina comercial, acompanhamento de propostas e organização executiva do processo de vendas.

Esta é uma vaga para quem gosta de ambiente estruturado, tem alta organização, aprende rápido e consegue transformar orientação em execução com pouca supervisão.

Modelo de trabalho

  • 100% Home Office
  • 30h semanais, em horário comercial
  • Bolsa-auxílio: R$ 1.712,98


O que essa pessoa vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Organizar briefings pré-reunião, reunindo histórico do cliente, materiais, objetivos e próximos passos
  • Acompanhar propostas comerciais do primeiro contato até o fechamento ou encerramento da oportunidade
  • Controlar status, prazos, follow-ups e versionamento de documentos
  • Apoiar a diretoria com agendas, pautas, atas e resumos executivos
  • Trabalhar com Microsoft 365, especialmente Excel, organização de arquivos e rotinas de acompanhamento
  • Atualizar planilhas e relatórios de pipeline, propostas e prazos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado
  • Excelente organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas ao mesmo tempo
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal
  • Pacote Office avançado, com boa desenvoltura em Excel, Word e PowerPoint
  • Atenção a detalhes e consistência em follow-ups
  • Condições reais para atuação em home office, com internet estável, ambiente silencioso, câmera e áudio funcionais
  • Disponibilidade para 30h semanais em horário comercial


Perfil que tende a se destacar nesta vaga

  • Pessoa com autonomia
  • Boa capacidade de raciocínio e priorização
  • Facilidade para registrar contexto, organizar pendências e manter continuidade de assuntos
  • Conforto para trabalhar com ritmo alto, múltiplas propostas e contato próximo com liderança


Elegibilidade

  • Estudantes com previsão de formatura entre dez/2026 e dez/2027
  • Cursos preferenciais: Administração, Marketing, Relações Públicas, Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Gestão Comercial ou Processos Gerenciais


Diferenciais

  • Noções de CRM
  • Experiência prévia com follow-up comercial, propostas ou rotinas de pré-vendas
  • Organização de documentos no SharePoint e OneDrive
  • Interesse em tecnologia, produtividade e ambiente Microsoft 365


Etapas do processo seletivo

  • Triagem inicial
  • Avaliações de lógica, comunicação e inglês
  • Entrevistas

Se você tem perfil analítico, organização forte e gosta de transformar processo em execução de qualidade, essa vaga pode fazer sentido para você.

Candidate-se pelo LinkedIn.

title: Estágio em Finanças e Controladoria
description:
Tem interesse em finanças? Quer trabalhar lado a lado com os times financeiros de algumas das startups mais ambiciosas do Brasil? Então, essa vaga é para você ;)


Se a vaga não tem o seu perfil, mas você conhece alguém que se encaixaria perfeitamente, marque o @ aqui!


Valores da Wink:

- Somos parceiros e criamos relações de longo prazo, pautadas em confiança;

- Somos empreendedores, inovadores e estamos sempre buscando aprender e melhorar;

- Nos orgulhamos das nossas diferenças e de como evoluímos a partir delas;

- Prezamos sempre pela verdade e transparência;

- Valorizamos o trabalho inteligente, com equilíbrio entre as vidas pessoal e profissional;

- Somos sérios e responsáveis, mas atuamos com leveza.


Principais Atividades:

- Apoiar os times financeiros das startups com melhorias de processos e dúvidas em suas operações financeiras;

- Auxiliar no controle e acompanhamento do fluxo de caixa e orçamento, em parceria com os times internos das startups;

- Participar da análise dos demonstrativos financeiros e apoiar com ajustes junto à contabilidade, para garantir que reflitam a realidade operacional das startups;

- Auxiliar na elaboração de relatórios gerenciais (ex. previsto vs. realizado, indicadores), que auxiliem nas tomadas de decisões dos empreendedores e das startups.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

- A partir do 5º período de Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia, Controladoria, Finanças e/ou áreas afins;

- Forte capacidade analítica, raciocínio lógico e matemático;

- Domínio do pacote Office / Ferramentas Google (em especial, Excel / Google Planilhas);

- Desejável conhecimento em Power BI, Chat GPT e/ou Claude AI.


Importante:

- Além dos requisitos e qualificações, é necessário que os candidatos e candidatas estejam de acordo com critérios de estágio determinados pelas faculdades/universidades.


Remuneração:

Bolsa de R$ 2.000/mês + R$ 300/mês de auxílio home office.

title: Desenvolvedor Infra-as-Code Multi-Cloud Pleno (Remoto)
description:

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

  • Vivência com ambientes VMware, especialmente vRealize Automation (vRA / vRO);
  • Conhecimento em sistemas Linux e Windows Server.

  • Conhecimento em cloud (Oracle OCI, Azure e AWS);
  • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e Git;
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade;
  • Certificações em cloud (OCI e AWS).
